info.description:
Backend API for dispatching aircraft maintenance engineers across the airport map.

Features:
- Route computation between any two map points.
- Automatic engineer assignment from a free-text problem description.
- Task acceptance / progress tracking.
- Geo endpoints for engineers, aircraft and special transport vehicles.
- JWT-based authentication (access + refresh tokens).
